AI and Digital Tools

How do I verify AI-generated content?

Short Answer

Check AI-generated information against trusted sources, organisational guidance and subject matter expertise before relying on or sharing it.

Detailed Guidance

Treat AI output as a starting point, not an authoritative source. Verify claims against current primary sources, check links and quotations, look for omissions or bias, and ask a subject matter expert to review high-impact content.
